about: Hospital family game (Dr. Li): rules and tree templates, no text. Each template has 7 people (user decision, 4 Nov 2026: 9 cards were too many choices); together they cover every relationship word. mothers_side (Stage 4) is big_family on the mother's side, so Chinese maternal terms come up. Every sentence is in data/phrases.json group 'family'; names come from data/names.json in the foreign language; relationship words are the Family words of data/words.json. Ages are computed from the game's shared 'today' (scripts/learning/game_clock.gd: a random date in 2026-2027, picked once per launch and shared with the airport flight game; user decision, 5 Nov 2026; it replaced the fixed reference_date 2026-11-04). A tree template lists people: 'gender' m/f, 'parents' (ids of people in the same template), 'partner' (id) with 'partner_kind' married/dating, given on ONE of the two partners, and a layout cell 'row' (generation, 0 = top) and 'col' (card columns, may be fractional). Put a partner who married or dated into the family on the OUTSIDE of the couple, so the line down to the children never runs over them. People without parents and without a partner who has parents are the oldest generation and get an age in 'root_age'; a child is born 'gap' years after its younger parent; a partner who married or dated into the family gets an age within 'partner_spread' years of their partner. Every age and every birth month in a round is different (so a tree has at most 12 people), and nobody is younger than 'min_age' (so Spanish never needs '1 año'). Questions: 'kinds' lists the question generators of scripts/learning/family_questions.gd with a pick weight. See docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md#hospital-family-game--4-november-2026.
